errors.quote: against an opponent who played an open Sicilian structure
errors.reason: At 0:03-0:11 he only says the opponent may or may not go open Sicilian, and at 16:26 calls the game technical, not aggressive; the opponent's choices (Qa4, Bf4) are not described as an open Sicilian.

errors.quote: though the video never states the final result outright
errors.reason: He treats the game as won ('easy win' 13:29, 'Kaching' 13:51, 'Keep the pawn' 16:14) and moves on to the next game, so the win is effectively conveyed.
The race at 29:00-33:50 involves rooks and a knight, not just kings and pawns (e.g. 'Rook D1', 'knight C3', 'rook B8').

errors.quote: el comunismo decrecentista y un crecimiento tecnológico selectivo guiado por la necesidad colectiva
errors.reason: The video presents Saito's degrowth communism as an example of the selective technological degrowth approach, not a separate approach (14:15-14:51).

errors.quote: la ventaja cuántica aparece solo en problemas muy artificiales y específicos
errors.reason: The video says many examples are equally artificial (17:41-17:47) but that problems of great usefulness may exist (17:30-17:40) and quantum data processing is promising (19:26-20:21), so 'solo' overgeneralizes.

errors.quote: two games by Karpov and a third game in which White wins
